# Jaek's Automotive

Jaek's Automotive is an auto repair shop in Van Nuys, California.
We are at 14254 Oxnard Street, Van Nuys, CA 91401.
We do oil changes, brake service, battery replacement, and tire rotation.
Jerry handles the repair work; Rebecca handles the front counter.
Hours are Monday through Friday, 7am to 5pm. Closed weekends.
Call (818) 786-6586 or email Info@jaeksautomotive.com.
We serve Van Nuys and the San Fernando Valley.
Every service includes a 12-month warranty.
